author: 丑満 ミコト

prediction.question: 父のノートに記された警告。志乃が次に目にするものは？
options: 地下図書館へと続く隠された扉
村人が隠し持つ忌まわしき祭具
蓮が語る父の失踪に関する真実

en.title: The Muddy Pages and the Funeral Procession of the Promised Hill
en.premise: Following her grandmother's death, Shino visits Mikami Village, a settlement cut off from the outside world. The village harbors a long-standing taboo ritual known as the 'Underground Library,' where the memories of the dead are recorded on paper and preserved. On the 'Promised Hill,' which the villagers view with dread, a festival is held once every few years, offering 'words' in place of a human sacrifice. As Shino traces the footsteps of her missing father, she confronts the horrifying truth that the village's faith has long concealed.

zh.title: 泥泞之页与约定之丘的送葬队列
zh.premise: 因祖母的去世，主角志乃来到了与世隔绝的御神村。村里流传着自古以来的禁忌仪式——被称为“地下图书馆”的场所，会将死者的记忆书写在纸上并加以保存。而在村民们心生畏惧的“约定之丘”上，每隔几年便会举行一次以“语言”代替活祭的祭礼。志乃在追寻失踪父亲足迹的过程中，逐渐逼近了村庄信仰所掩盖的可怕真相。
